newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on Sonae.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on Sonae.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Portuguese shares closed weaker, dragged down by retail and real estate group Sonae Investimentos which fell 2.3 percent after announcing its 1996 results. Some dealers said the drop in Sonae shares was due to profit taking as the results came out at the top end of analysts' expectations. However, some analysts said the market had expected a higher 1996 dividend than the 150 escudos per share, unchanged from 1995, announced today. Dealers expected the Lisbon market to ease tomorrow, correcting from recent gains. "I think the weaker tone will be maintained tomorrow," said one operator. "Turnover should increase."
